title: Identifying Latent-Outcome Treatment Effects across a Tree of Overlapping Measurement Links
banked_reason: D0.5.G: delivered tier incremental below field floor; fixed-model affine criterion uses latent contrast and support, and no bounded in-scope repair reaches field novelty.
gap_reasons: The headline theorem exactly characterizes invariance only after fixing the latent model, including the unobserved terminal contrast measure and latent support values; its finite test therefore cannot be evaluated from the observed study law.
The same-observed-law construction proves that neither this criterion nor the ALTE is identified over the declared connected class.

The framing accurately discloses these limitations, but no estimator, identified set, observable diagnostic, or substantive application converts the fixed-model algebra into a field-level econometric result.
paper_score_ceiling 5.4 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 derived positive same-observed-law causal twins, target-specific contrast transport, and an exact fixed-model affine solution-fiber criterion. D0.5 judged this mathematically incremental because the exact criterion requires latent-law inputs unavailable from the observed study law; an observable sharp identified-set algorithm would require a new, restricted partial-identification project. A Bayes posterior determinant error was corrected after review, preserving the local-completeness conclusion; no Lean formalization was started.
tldr: The fixed-kernel one-edge theorem gives the local affine base-plus-nullspace criterion, and the headline couples it across the observed tree.  For a fixed latent tree model, terminal ALTE identification for every terminal-integrable observed tree solution is exactly a whole-tree affine-annihilator condition: one base residual and every homogeneous terminal perturbation must integrate to zero against the terminal contrast.  On finite supports this is the explicit test \(c_t=A^\top\lambda\) and \(\delta_t^\top x=\lambda^\top b\).  Pathwise contrast domination and the stronger continuing-pooled-law package remain transparent sufficient certificates, but a positive nondegenerate witness shows that the exact criterion strictly contains both.  Same-observed-law models with identical global kernels can disagree on the criterion, so it is fixed-model and latent-law dependent rather than an observable causal if-and-only-if result.  The internal common-benchmark comparison makes no containment claim about the Fu--Green published analytic class.
gap: Fu and Green (2026) calibrate the latent scale through Assumption 1 and retain one benchmark in every study, while psychometric chain linking and finite-battery nonidentification do not provide a causal transport theorem for rotating pairwise batteries across changing latent populations.
fill: The project gives a conditional rooted-tree transport theorem that propagates the already calibrated root scale under explicit bridge feasibility, discrepancy soundness, continuing pooled-law domination, and terminal contrast-total-variation domination; a matched class comparison and rotating member isolate the incidence gain, and a same-law twin supplies the diagnostic boundary.
